content.value_statement: React Native apps can suffer from slow lists, extra renders, and JS thread stalls. This skill provides focused patterns for faster FlatList screens, memoized components, optimized selectors, cached images, and profiling.
actual_capabilities: Guides stable FlatList keyExtractor, renderItem, and getItemLayout patterns.
Explains when to consider FlashList for large or complex lists.
Shows useMemo, useCallback, and React.memo patterns for reducing re-renders.
Improves Zustand selector usage with focused selectors and shallow comparison.
Covers expo-image caching, render detection, and JS thread deferral patterns.
Provides a checklist for diagnosing jank, slow renders, memory growth, and UI freezes.
limitations: It does not run profilers or benchmark app performance by itself.
Examples assume React Native, Expo, and TypeScript-style codebases.
FlashList guidance requires separate dependency evaluation and device testing.
It does not replace performance testing on real low-end devices.

use_cases.title: Fix Janky List Screens
use_cases.description: Diagnose slow FlatList screens and apply stable keys, item layout, memoized rows, and render window settings.

use_cases.title: Review Release Performance
use_cases.description: Check list-heavy screens for avoidable renders, expensive selectors, image cache issues, and JS thread blocking before release.

use_cases.title: Teach Render Hygiene
use_cases.description: Use the examples to explain when memoization helps, when it adds overhead, and how to profile render behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Find Simple List Issues
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit of one list screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this React Native list screen for obvious performance issues. Focus on stable keys, renderItem, getItemLayout, and inline callbacks.

prompt_templates.title: Reduce Re-Renders
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these components for unnecessary re-renders. Recommend where React.memo, useMemo, useCallback, or StyleSheet.create would help.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize State Selectors
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Zustand usage for selector problems. Suggest focused selectors, shallow comparison, and safer component boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Performance Pass
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prioritized performance plan for this React Native feature. Include profiling steps, list changes, image handling, memoization, and JS thread risks.

output_examples.input: A player directory screen stutters while scrolling through hundreds of rows.
output: Use stable item keys based on player IDs.
Move row rendering into a memoized item component.
Add getItemLayout if row height is fixed.
Consider FlashList if profiling still shows list bottlenecks.

output_examples.input: A dashboard re-renders every card when one Zustand value changes.
output: Avoid selecting the whole store in the dashboard.
Use specific selectors for each card value.
Use shallow comparison when a component needs several related values.
Profile again to confirm only changed cards render.

output_examples.input: A screen freezes briefly after navigation when it calculates rankings.
output: Profile the JS thread during navigation.
Defer heavy work until after interactions complete.
Memoize ranking inputs when they are reused.
Move long-running computation away from the initial render path.

best_practices: Profile first, then optimize the component or list that actually causes delay.
Use stable props and selectors before adding broad memoization.
Validate improvements on real devices, especially lower-end Android hardware.
anti_patterns: Do not memoize every simple value without measuring the cost.
Do not pass inline objects or callbacks into memoized child components.
Do not select an entire Zustand store when a component needs only one value.

faq.question: Does this skill change my app code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance and examples that an assistant can apply with your approval.

faq.question: When should I use FlashList instead of FlatList?
faq.answer: Consider FlashList for very large lists, complex rows, or cases where optimized FlatList screens still show scroll jank.

faq.question: Can this help with Expo apps?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples include Expo-friendly guidance such as expo-image caching and React Native profiling workflows.

faq.question: Does React.memo always improve performance?
faq.answer: No. It helps when props are stable and renders are expensive, but it can add overhead for simple components.

faq.question: How should I verify an optimization worked?
faq.answer: Use React DevTools Profiler, targeted render logging, and device testing before and after each change.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
